source: Arabic texts compiled from the Sunnah (Hisn al-Muslim selection). English & transliteration: Shukr.

items.ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾.
items.tl: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim. Allahu la ilaha illa huwa, al-Hayyul-Qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bi-shay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa huwal-'Aliyyul-'Azim.
items.en: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed. ﴿Allah — there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him, nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is there that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what lies before them and what lies behind them, while they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them both does not burden Him. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.﴾

items.ar: (بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ* اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾.) (بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾.) (بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾)
items.tl:
(Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul huwa Allahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.)

(Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul a'udhu bi Rabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.)

(Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul a'udhu bi Rabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi suduril-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.)
items.en:
(In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. Say: "He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge, on whom all depend. He has never had offspring, nor was He born. And there is none comparable to Him.")

(In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. Say: "I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.")

(In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. Say: "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the sly whisperer who withdraws, who whispers into the hearts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.")

items.ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ. [ وإذا أمسى قال: أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه] [وإذا أمسى قال: رب أسألك خير ما في هذه الليلة، وخير ما بعدها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما في هذه الليلة، وشر ما بعدها.]
items.tl: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhal-yawm wa khayra ma ba'dah, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhal-yawm wa sharri ma ba'dah. Rabbi a'udhu bika minal-kasali wa su'il-kibar. Rabbi a'udhu bika min 'adhabin fin-nar wa 'adhabin fil-qabr. [Wa idha amsa qala: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah.] [Wa idha amsa qala: Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhihil-laylah, wa khayra ma ba'daha, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhihil-laylah, wa sharri ma ba'daha.]
items.en: We have entered the morning, and all sovereignty has entered the morning belonging to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and from the misery of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from a punishment in the Fire and a punishment in the grave. [When evening comes, one says: We have entered the evening, and all sovereignty has entered the evening belonging to Allah.] [And when evening comes, one says: My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it.]

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا ، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ. [وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم بك أمسينا، وبك أصبحنا، وبك نحيا، وبك نموت، وإليك المصير.]
items.tl: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykan-nushur. [Wa idha amsa qal: Allahumma bika amsayna, wa bika asbahna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykal-masir.]
items.en: O Allah, by Your grace we have reached the morning, and by Your grace we have reached the evening; by Your will we live, and by Your will we die, and to You is the Resurrection. [And when evening comes, he would say: O Allah, by Your grace we have reached the evening, and by Your grace we have reached the morning; by Your will we live, and by Your will we die, and to You is the final return.]

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ.
items.tl: Allahumma anta Rabbi, la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana abduka, wa ana ala ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u laka bi ni'matika alayya, wa abu'u bi dhanbi faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta.
items.en: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me, and I am Your servant, and I hold to my covenant with You and my promise to You as far as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me, and I acknowledge my sin. So forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ (أربعَ مَرَّاتٍ).[ وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم إني أمسيت...]
items.tl: Allahumma inni asbahtu ushhiduka, wa ushhidu hamalata 'arshika, wa mala'ikataka, wa jami'a khalqika, annaka antallahu la ilaha illa anta wahdaka la sharika laka, wa anna Muhammadan 'abduka wa rasuluka (arba'a marratin). [Wa idha amsa qala: Allahumma inni amsaytu...]
items.en: O Allah, I have entered the morning calling You to witness, and calling to witness the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation, that You are Allah, there is no god but You alone, You have no partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and Your Messenger. (Say this four times.) [In the evening, he says: O Allah, I have entered the evening...]

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ. [وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم ما أمسى بي...]
items.tl: Allahumma ma asbaha bi min ni'matin aw bi ahadin min khalqika faminka wahdaka la sharika lak, falakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr. [Wa idha amsa qala: Allahumma ma amsa bi...]
items.en: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me this morning, or to any of Your creation, is from You alone; You have no partner. So all praise belongs to You, and to You belongs all thanks. [In the evening, one says: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me this evening...]

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ، وَالفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
items.tl: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa Anta. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr, wa a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr, la ilaha illa Anta. (Thalatha marrat)
items.en: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight. There is no god but You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is no god but You. (Repeat three times.)

items.ar: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ عَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ (سَبْعَ مَرّاتٍ).
items.tl: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu, wa huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azeem (sab'a marraat).
items.en: Allah is enough for me; there is no god but Him. In Him I place my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne. (Say this seven times.)

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ: فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي، وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَينِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي.
items.tl: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali. Allahummastur 'awrati wa amin raw'ati. Allahummahfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi wa 'an yamini wa 'an shimali wa min fawqi, wa a'udhu bi 'azamatika an ughtala min tahti.
items.en: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth. O Allah, cover my flaws and shortcomings, and calm my fears. O Allah, guard me from before me and from behind me, from my right and from my left, and from above me. And I seek refuge in Your greatness from being struck down unexpectedly from beneath me.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشَرَكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ.
items.tl: Allahumma 'alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shay'in wa malikah, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa ant, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharrish-shaytani wa sharakih, wa an aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an, aw ajurrahu ila muslim.
items.en: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of everything: I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self, and from the evil of Satan and his snare (or his association of partners with Allah), and from committing any wrong against myself or bringing it upon another Muslim.

items.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
items.tl: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i, wa huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim. (Thalatha marratin)
items.en: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. (Recite three times.)

items.ar: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيّاً (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
items.tl: Radheetu billaahi rabbaa, wa bil-Islaami deenaa, wa bi-Muhammadin (sallallahu alayhi wa sallam) nabiyyaa (thalaatha marraat).
items.en: I am content with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (ﷺ) as my Prophet. (Say this three times.)

items.ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِيَ كُلَّهُ وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ.
items.tl: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyumu, bi-rahmatika astaghith. Aslih li sha'ni kullahu, wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn.
items.en: O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining Sustainer of all, through Your mercy I cry out for help. Set right all my affairs for me, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.

items.ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُـمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ:فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ. [وإذا أمسى قال: أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه ربّ العالمين اللَّهم إني أسألك خير هذه الليلة: فتحها، ونصرها، ونورها، وبركتها، وهداها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما فيها، وشر ما بعدها.]
items.tl: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillahi Rabbil-'alamin. Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra hadhal-yawm: fathahu, wa nasrahu, wa nurahu, wa barakatahu, wa hudahu, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fihi wa sharri ma ba'dahu. [Wa idha amsa qala: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillahi Rabbil-'alamin. Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra hadhihil-laylah: fathaha, wa nasraha, wa nuraha, wa barakataha, wa hudaha, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fiha wa sharri ma ba'daha.]
items.en: We have entered the morning, and all dominion has entered the morning belonging to Allah, Lord of all the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its opening, its victory, its light, its blessing, and its guidance. And I seek refuge in You from the evil within it and the evil that follows it. [When evening comes, he says: We have entered the evening, and all dominion has entered the evening belonging to Allah, Lord of all the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night: its opening, its victory, its light, its blessing, and its guidance. And I seek refuge in You from the evil within it and the evil that follows it.]

items.ar: أَصْبَحْنا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشرِكِينَ. [وإذا أمسى قال: أمسينا على فطرة الإسلام...]
items.tl: Asbahna 'ala fitratil-Islam, wa 'ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa 'ala dini nabiyyina Muhammadin (sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam), wa 'ala millati abina Ibrahim, hanifan musliman wa ma kana minal-mushrikin. [Wa idha amsa qala: Amsayna 'ala fitratil-Islam...]
items.en: We have entered the morning upon the natural disposition of Islam, upon the word of sincere devotion, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ), and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, who was upright and submitted to God, and was never among those who associate partners with Him. [When entering the evening, he would say: We have entered the evening upon the natural disposition of Islam...]

items.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ (مائة مرَّةٍ).
items.tl: Subhan Allahi wa bihamdih (mi'ata marrah).
items.en: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him (said one hundred times).

items.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ (عشرَ مرَّات) ، أَوْ (مرَّةً واحدةً عندَ الكَسَلِ).
items.tl: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. ('Ashra marrat, aw marratan wahidatan 'indal-kasal.)
items.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things. (Ten times, or once if one feels lazy.)

items.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ (مائةَ مرَّةٍ إذا أصبحَ).
items.tl: La ilaha illallah, wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir (mi'ata marratin idha asbaha).
items.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is all praise, and He has power over all things. (To be said one hundred times upon waking in the morning.)
items.note: Can be completed through the day

items.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ إذا أصبحَ).
items.tl: Subhan Allahi wa bihamdihi: 'adada khalqihi, wa rida nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midada kalimatihi (thalatha marratin idha asbaha).
items.en: Glory be to Allah, and praise be to Him: as many times as the number of His creation, as much as pleases Him, as much as the weight of His Throne, and as much as the ink of His words. (To be said three times in the morning.)

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً (إذا أصبحَ).
items.tl: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan (idha asbaha).
items.en: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good and lawful provision, and deeds that are accepted. (To be said when morning comes.)

items.ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ (مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ فِي الْيَوْمِ).
items.tl: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh (mi'ata marratin fil-yawm).
items.en: I seek Allah's forgiveness and I turn back to Him in repentance (one hundred times a day).
items.note: Can be completed through the day

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبَيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ (عشرَ مرَّاتٍ).
items.tl: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala nabiyyina Muhammad (ten times).
items.en: O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ). (Recite ten times.)

items.ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾.
items.tl: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim. Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm, lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard, man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih, ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-arda, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa huwal-'aliyyul-'azim.
items.en: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed. "Allah: there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him, nor sleep. To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth. Who is there that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and guarding them does not burden Him. And He is the Most High, the Most Great."

items.ar: (بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ* اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾.) (بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾.) (بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾)
items.tl:
Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul huwa Allahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.
Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul a'udhu bi Rabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.
Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul a'udhu bi Rabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi suduril-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.
items.en:
(In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. Say: "He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Self-Sufficient Master to whom all turn. He has not fathered anyone, nor was He fathered. And there is none comparable to Him.")
(In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. Say: "I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of all that He has created, from the evil of the darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow upon knots, and from the evil of the envier when he envies.")
(In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. Say: "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the sneaking whisperer, who whispers into the hearts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.")

items.ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ. [ وإذا أمسى قال: أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه] [وإذا أمسى قال: رب أسألك خير ما في هذه الليلة، وخير ما بعدها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما في هذه الليلة، وشر ما بعدها.]
items.tl: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhal-yawm wa khayra ma ba'dah, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhal-yawm wa sharri ma ba'dah. Rabbi a'udhu bika minal-kasali wa su'il-kibar. Rabbi a'udhu bika min 'adhabin fin-nar wa 'adhabin fil-qabr. [Wa idha amsa qala: amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah.] [Wa idha amsa qala: Rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadhihil-laylah, wa khayra ma ba'daha, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhihil-laylah, wa sharri ma ba'daha.]
items.en: We have entered the morning, and all sovereignty has entered the morning belonging to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is all praise, and He has power over all things. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and from the misery of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from a punishment in the Fire and a punishment in the grave. [When evening comes, one says: 'We have entered the evening, and all sovereignty has entered the evening belonging to Allah.'] [And when evening comes, one says: 'My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it.']

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا ، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ. [وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم بك أمسينا، وبك أصبحنا، وبك نحيا، وبك نموت، وإليك المصير.]
items.tl: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykan-nushur. [Wa idha amsa qala: Allahumma bika amsayna, wa bika asbahna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykal-masir.]
items.en: O Allah, by Your grace we have reached the morning, and by Your grace we reach the evening; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection. [And when evening comes, he would say: O Allah, by Your grace we have reached the evening, and by Your grace we reach the morning; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the final return.]

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ.
items.tl: Allahumma anta rabbi, la ilaha illa ant. Khalaqtani wa ana abduk, wa ana ala ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't. A'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't. Abu'u laka bi ni'matika alayya, wa abu'u bi dhanbi, faghfir li, fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant.
items.en: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me, and I am Your servant, and I remain upon Your covenant and Your promise as far as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me, and I acknowledge my sin. So forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ (أربعَ مَرَّاتٍ).[ وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم إني أمسيت...]
items.tl: Allahumma inni asbahtu ushhiduka, wa ushhidu hamalata 'arshika, wa mala'ikataka, wa jami'a khalqika, annaka antallahu la ilaha illa anta wahdaka la sharika lak, wa anna Muhammadan 'abduka wa rasuluk. (Arba'a marrat). [Wa idha amsa qala: Allahumma inni amsaytu...]
items.en: O Allah, I have entered the morning calling You to witness — and calling to witness the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation — that You are Allah, there is no god but You alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is Your servant and Your Messenger. (Say this four times.) [In the evening, say: O Allah, I have entered the evening...]

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ. [وإذا أمسى قال: اللَّهم ما أمسى بي...]
items.tl: Allahumma ma asbaha bi min ni'matin aw bi-ahadin min khalqika faminka wahdaka la sharika lak, falakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr. [Wa idha amsa qala: Allahumma ma amsa bi...]
items.en: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me this morning, or to any of Your creation, is from You alone, with no partner. So all praise is Yours, and all thanks are Yours. [In the evening, he would say: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me this evening...]

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ، وَالفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
items.tl: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa Ant. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr, wa a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr, la ilaha illa Ant. (Thalatha marrat)
items.en: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight. There is no god but You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and from poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is no god but You. (Repeat three times.)

items.ar: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ عَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ (سَبْعَ مَرّاتٍ).
items.tl: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa, alayhi tawakkaltu, wa huwa Rabbul-arshil-azeem. (Sab'a marrat)
items.en: Allah is enough for me; there is no god but Him. In Him I have placed my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne. (Recite seven times.)

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ: فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي، وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَينِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي.
items.tl: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali. Allahummastur 'awrati wa amin raw'ati. Allahummahfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfi wa 'an yamini wa 'an shimali wa min fawqi, wa a'udhu bi'azamatika an ughtala min tahti.
items.en: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly life, my family, and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my flaws and shortcomings, and calm my fears. O Allah, guard me from in front of me and from behind me, from my right and from my left, and from above me. And I seek refuge in Your greatness from being struck down suddenly from beneath me.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشَرَكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ.
items.tl: Allahumma 'alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shay'in wa malikah, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa anta, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharrish-shaytani wa sharakih, wa an aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an, aw ajurrahu ila muslim.
items.en: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of everything: I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self, and from the evil of Satan and his snare (or his association of partners with Allah), and from committing any wrong against myself or dragging it onto another Muslim.

items.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
items.tl: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i, wa huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim (thalatha marrat).
items.en: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. (Recite three times.)

items.ar: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيّاً (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
items.tl: Radeetu billaahi rabbaa, wa bil-Islaami deenaa, wa bi Muhammadin (sallallahu alayhi wa sallam) nabiyyaa. (Thalaatha marraat)
items.en: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (ﷺ) as my Prophet. (Recite three times.)

items.ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِيَ كُلَّهُ وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ.
items.tl: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, bi-rahmatika astaghith. Aslih li sha'ni kullahu, wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn.
items.en: O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining Sustainer of all, through Your mercy I call out for help. Set right all of my affairs for me, and do not leave me to myself, not even for the blink of an eye.

items.ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُـمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ:فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ. [وإذا أمسى قال: أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه ربّ العالمين اللَّهم إني أسألك خير هذه الليلة: فتحها، ونصرها، ونورها، وبركتها، وهداها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما فيها، وشر ما بعدها.]
items.tl: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillahi Rabbil-'alamin. Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra hadhal-yawm: fathahu, wa nasrahu, wa nurahu, wa barakatahu, wa hudahu, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fihi wa sharri ma ba'dahu. [Wa idha amsa qala: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillahi Rabbil-'alamin. Allahumma inni as'aluka khayra hadhihil-laylah: fathaha, wa nasraha, wa nuraha, wa barakataha, wa hudaha, wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fiha wa sharri ma ba'daha.]
items.en: We have entered the morning, and the dominion has entered the morning belonging to Allah, Lord of all the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its opening, its victory, its light, its blessing, and its guidance. I seek refuge in You from the evil that is within it and the evil that comes after it. [And when evening comes, he says: We have entered the evening, and the dominion has entered the evening belonging to Allah, Lord of all the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this night: its opening, its victory, its light, its blessing, and its guidance. I seek refuge in You from the evil that is within it and the evil that comes after it.]

items.ar: أَصْبَحْنا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشرِكِينَ. [وإذا أمسى قال: أمسينا على فطرة الإسلام...]
items.tl: Asbahna 'ala fitratil-Islam, wa 'ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa 'ala dini nabiyyina Muhammadin (sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam), wa 'ala millati abina Ibrahim, hanifan musliman wa ma kana minal-mushrikin. [Wa idha amsa qala: Amsayna 'ala fitratil-Islam...]
items.en: We have entered the morning upon the natural disposition of Islam, upon the word of sincere devotion, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ), and upon the way of our father Ibrahim, who turned away from falsehood, submitting to Allah, and was never among those who associate others with Him. [In the evening, one says: We have entered the evening upon the natural disposition of Islam...]

items.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ (مائة مرَّةٍ).
items.tl: Subhan Allahi wa bihamdihi (mi'ata marrah).
items.en: Glory be to Allah, and praise belongs to Him (said one hundred times).

items.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ (عشرَ مرَّات) ، أَوْ (مرَّةً واحدةً عندَ الكَسَلِ).
items.tl: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. (Ten times, or once at a time of laziness.)
items.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is all praise, and He has power over all things. (Say this ten times, or once if you are feeling lazy or sluggish.)

items.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ (مائةَ مرَّةٍ إذا أصبحَ).
items.tl: La ilaha illallah, wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. (Mi'ata marrah idha asbah)
items.en: There is no god but Allah, alone, with no partner. To Him belongs all dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things. (To be said one hundred times in the morning.)
items.note: Can be completed through the day

items.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ إذا أصبحَ).
items.tl: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi: 'adada khalqihi, wa rida nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midada kalimatihi (thalatha marratin idha asbaha).
items.en: Glory and praise be to Allah: as many times as the number of His creation, as much as pleases Him, as heavy as the weight of His Throne, and as vast as the ink that would record His words. (Say this three times in the morning.)

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً (إذا أصبحَ).
items.tl: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan (idha asbaha).
items.en: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good and lawful provision, and deeds that are accepted. (To be said in the morning.)

items.ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ (مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ فِي الْيَوْمِ).
items.tl: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh (mi'ata marratin fil-yawm).
items.en: I seek Allah's forgiveness and I turn back to Him in repentance (one hundred times a day).
items.note: Can be completed through the day

items.ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ (ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ إذا أمسى).
items.tl: A'udhu bi kalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq (thalatha marratin idha amsa).
items.en: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created. (Say this three times in the evening.)

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبَيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ (عشرَ مرَّاتٍ).
items.tl: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala nabiyyina Muhammad (ten times).
items.en: O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ). (Repeat ten times.)

items.ar: يَجْمَعُ كَفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ يَنْفُثُ فِيهِمَا فَيَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا:بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ * اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾. بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾. بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾ ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ يَبْدَأُ بِهِمَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَوَجْهِهِ وَمَا أَقبَلَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ (يفعلُ ذلك ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ).
items.tl: Yajma'u kaffayhi thumma yanfuthu feehima fayaqra'u feehima: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem. Qul huwa Allahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yoolad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad. Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem. Qul a'oothu bi Rabbil-falaq. Min sharrima khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin itha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin itha hasad. Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem. Qul a'oothu bi Rabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas. Thumma yamsahu bihima mastata'a min jasadihi, yabda'u bihima 'ala ra'sihi wa wajhihi wa ma aqbala min jasadihi (yaf'alu dhalika thalatha marrat).
items.en: He would cup his palms together and blow lightly into them, then recite into them: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. {Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Self-Sufficient Master, upon whom all depend. He neither begets nor was He begotten. And there is none comparable to Him.} In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. {Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, and from the evil of the darkness when it settles, and from the evil of those who blow into knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.} In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. {Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the whispering withdrawer, who whispers into the hearts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.} Then he would wipe over as much of his body as he could with them, beginning with his head and face and the front of his body. (He would do this three times.)

items.ar: ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْـــــــــــدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾.
items.tl: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa, al-Hayyul-Qayyum. La ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. Man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih. Ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bi-shay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifdhuhuma, wa huwal-'Aliyyul-'Adhim.
items.en: Allah — there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is there that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what lies before them and what lies behind them, while they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not burden Him. And He is the Most High, the Supreme.

items.ar: ﴿آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلآئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ* لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾.
items.tl: Amanar-rasulu bima unzila ilayhi min rabbihi wal-mu'minun, kullun amana billahi wa mala'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulih, la nufarriqu bayna ahadin min rusulih, wa qalu sami'na wa ata'na, ghufranaka rabbana wa ilaykal-masir. La yukallifullahu nafsan illa wus'aha, laha ma kasabat wa 'alayha maktasabat, rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na, rabbana wa la tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'alal-ladhina min qablina, rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih, wa'fu 'anna waghfir lana warhamna, anta mawlana fansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin.
items.en:
The Messenger believes in what has been sent down to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. Each one believes in Allah, His angels, His books, and His messengers: "We make no distinction between any of His messengers." And they say, "We have heard and we obey. We seek Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the final return."
Allah does not burden any soul beyond its capacity. It receives the good it has earned, and bears the harm it has earned. "Our Lord, do not hold us accountable if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not lay on us a heavy burden such as You laid on those before us. Our Lord, do not make us carry what we have no strength to bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us against the disbelieving people."

items.ar: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِن أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ.
items.tl: Bismika rabbi wada'tu janbi, wa bika arfa'uhu, fa in amsakta nafsi farhamha, wa in arsaltaha fahfazha, bima tahfazu bihi 'ibadakas-salihin.
items.en: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by Your leave I raise it up. If You take my soul, have mercy on it; and if You send it back, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْياهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ.
items.tl: Allahumma innaka khalaqta nafsi wa anta tawaffaha, laka mamatuha wa mahyaha, in ahyaytaha fahfazha, wa in amattaha faghfir laha. Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afiyah.
items.en: O Allah, You created my soul and You will take it back. Its death and its life belong to You. If You keep it alive, protect it; and if You cause it to die, forgive it. O Allah, I ask You for well-being.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ.
items.tl: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak.
items.en: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.

items.ar: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا.
items.tl: Bismika Allahumma amootu wa ahya.
items.en: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

items.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (أربعاً وثلاثينَ).
items.tl: Subhanallah (thalathan wa thalathin), wal-hamdu lillah (thalathan wa thalathin), wallahu akbar (arba'an wa thalathin).
items.en: Glory be to Allah (thirty-three times), and all praise is for Allah (thirty-three times), and Allah is the Greatest (thirty-four times).

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ، وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ.
items.tl: Allahumma Rabbas-samawatis-sab'i wa Rabbal-ard, wa Rabbal-'Arshil-'Azim, Rabbana wa Rabba kulli shay', faliqal-habbi wan-nawa, wa munzilat-Tawrati wal-Injili wal-Furqan, a'udhu bika min sharri kulli shay'in anta akhidhun bi-nasiyatih. Allahumma antal-Awwalu falaysa qablaka shay', wa antal-Akhiru falaysa ba'daka shay', wa antaz-Zahiru falaysa fawqaka shay', wa antal-Batinu falaysa dunaka shay'. Iqdi 'annad-dayna wa aghnina minal-faqr.
items.en: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Mighty Throne; our Lord and the Lord of everything; Splitter of the grain and the date-stone; Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel, and the Criterion (the Quran): I seek refuge in You from the evil of everything whose forelock You hold. O Allah, You are the First, so nothing precedes You; and You are the Last, so nothing comes after You; You are the Most Manifest (Az-Zahir), so nothing is above You; and You are the Most Hidden (Al-Batin), so nothing is beyond You. Settle our debts for us, and enrich us so that we are free from poverty.

items.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُؤْوِيَ.
items.tl: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amana wa saqana, wa kafana, wa awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wa la mu'wiya.
items.en: All praise is for Allah, who gave us food and drink, who sufficed us and gave us shelter. How many there are who have no one to suffice them and no one to shelter them.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ.
items.tl: Allahumma 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, Fatiras-samawati wal-ard, Rabba kulli shay'in wa Malikah, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa Ant, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkih, wa an aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an, aw ajurrahu ila Muslim.
items.en: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of everything: I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own self, from the evil of Satan and his call to associate partners with Allah, and from bringing wrongdoing upon myself or dragging it toward any Muslim.

items.ar: يَقْرَأُ ﴿الم﴾ تَنْزِيلَ السَّجْدَة ِ، وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ.
items.tl: Yaqra'u Alif Lam Mim Tanzil as-Sajdah, wa Tabarakal-ladhi bi-yadihil-mulk.
items.en: He would recite Alif Lam Mim, the revelation of As-Sajdah (Surah As-Sajdah), and Tabarak alladhi bi-yadihi al-mulk (Surah Al-Mulk).

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ.
items.tl: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilayk, wa alja'tu zahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, la malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilayk, amantu bi kitabikal-ladhi anzalt, wa bi nabiyyikal-ladhi arsalt.
items.en: O Allah, I have submitted myself to You, entrusted my affair to You, turned my face toward You, and leaned my back upon You, out of hope in You and fear of You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except in You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed, and in Your Prophet whom You have sent.

items.ar: (.الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا، وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ )
items.tl: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana, wa ilayhin-nushur.
items.en: All praise belongs to Allah, who gave us life after He had caused us to die, and to Him is the final return.

items.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَريكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكبَرُ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبِّ اغْفرْ لِي
items.tl: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Subhanallah, walhamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil-'aliyyil-'azim. Rabbighfir li.
items.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; to Him belongs all dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He has power over all things. Glory be to Allah, and all praise is for Allah, and there is no god but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. There is no might and no power except with Allah, the Most High, the Almighty. My Lord, forgive me.

items.ar: ( الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لي بِذِكْرِهِ )
items.tl: Alhamdu lillahilladhi 'afani fi jasadi, wa radda 'alayya ruhi, wa adhina li bidhikrihi.
items.en: All praise is for Allah, who granted me well-being in my body, returned my soul to me, and permitted me to remember Him.

items.ar: ﴿ إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلاَفِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لأُوْلِي الألْبَابِ * الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَاماً وَقُعُوداً وَعَلَىَ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذا بَاطِلاً سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ* رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ* رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِياً يُنَادِي لِلإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الأبْرَارِ* رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلاَ تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لاَ تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ* فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لاَ أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِّنكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَى بَعْضُكُم مِّن بَعْضٍ فَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ وَأُخْرِجُواْ مِن دِيَارِهِمْ وَأُوذُواْ فِي سَبِيلِي وَقَاتَلُواْ وَقُتِلُواْ لأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ ثَوَاباً مِّن عِندِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ * لاَ يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي الْبِلاَدِ * مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ * لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْاْ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلاً مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّلأَبْرَارِ * وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَاشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لاَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَناً قَلِيلاً أُوْلَئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ*يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ اصْبِرُواْ وَصَابِرُواْ وَرَابِطُواْ وَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ﴾
items.tl: Inna fi khalqis-samawati wal-ard, wakhtilafil-layli wan-nahari la-ayatin li-ulil-albab. Alladhina yadhkurunallaha qiyaman wa qu'udan wa 'ala junubihim, wa yatafakkaruna fi khalqis-samawati wal-ard. Rabbana ma khalaqta hadha batila, subhanaka faqina 'adhaban-nar. Rabbana innaka man tudkhilin-nara faqad akhzaytah, wa ma liz-zalimina min ansar. Rabbana innana sami'na munadiyan yunadi lil-iman an aminu bi-rabbikum fa-amanna. Rabbana faghfir lana dhunubana wa kaffir 'anna sayyi'atina wa tawaffana ma'al-abrar. Rabbana wa atina ma wa'adtana 'ala rusulika wa la tukhzina yawmal-qiyamah, innaka la tukhliful-mi'ad. Fastajaba lahum rabbuhum anni la udi'u 'amala 'amilin minkum min dhakarin aw untha, ba'dukum min ba'd. Fal-ladhina hajaru wa ukhriju min diyarihim wa udhu fi sabili wa qatalu wa qutilu la-ukaffiranna 'anhum sayyi'atihim wa la-udkhilannahum jannatin tajri min tahtihal-anhar, thawaban min 'indillah, wallahu 'indahu husnuth-thawab. La yaghurrannaka taqallubul-ladhina kafaru fil-bilad. Mata'un qalilun thumma ma'wahum jahannam, wa bi'sal-mihad. Lakinil-ladhinattaqaw rabbahum lahum jannatun tajri min tahtihal-anharu khalidina fiha nuzulan min 'indillah, wa ma 'indallahi khayrun lil-abrar. Wa inna min ahlil-kitabi laman yu'minu billahi wa ma unzila ilaykum wa ma unzila ilayhim khashi'ina lillah, la yashtaruna bi-ayatillahi thamanan qalila. Ula'ika lahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim, innallaha sari'ul-hisab. Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanus-biru wa sabiru wa rabitu wattaqullaha la'allakum tuflihun.
items.en: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth, and in the alternation of night and day, there are signs for people of understanding. They are those who remember God standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and who reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth, saying: 'Our Lord, You did not create this in vain. Glory be to You! Protect us from the punishment of the Fire. Our Lord, whomever You admit into the Fire, You have truly disgraced, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers. Our Lord, we heard a caller calling us to faith, saying: Believe in your Lord, and we believed. Our Lord, forgive us our sins, erase our misdeeds, and take our souls in the company of the righteous. Our Lord, grant us what You promised us through Your messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You never break Your promise.' So their Lord answered them: 'I will never let the deed of any doer among you be lost, whether male or female; you are one from another. So those who emigrated, who were driven out of their homes, who were harmed in My cause, and who fought and were killed, I will surely erase their misdeeds and admit them into gardens beneath which rivers flow, as a reward from God. And with God is the finest reward.' Do not let the free movement of those who disbelieve across the lands deceive you. It is a brief enjoyment; then their refuge is Hell, and wretched is that resting place. But those who were mindful of their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding in them forever, as a welcome from God. And what is with God is best for the righteous. And among the People of the Book there are indeed some who believe in God, and in what was sent down to you and what was sent down to them, humbling themselves before God. They do not trade God's verses for a small price. Those will have their reward with their Lord. Indeed, God is swift in reckoning. O you who believe, be patient, outdo others in patience, stand firm at your posts, and be mindful of God, so that you may succeed.

items.ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ (ثَلاَثَاً) اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ.
items.tl: Astaghfirullah (3 times). Allahumma antas-salam, wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram.
items.en: I seek Allah's forgiveness (three times). O Allah, You are As-Salam (the Source of Peace), and from You comes all peace. Blessed and exalted are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor.

items.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ [ثلاثاً]، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الجَدُّ.
items.tl: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir (three times). Allahumma la mani'a lima a'taYta, wa la mu'tiya lima mana'ta, wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.
items.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is all praise, and He has power over everything. [Say three times.] O Allah, none can withhold what You have given, and none can give what You have withheld, and the might of the mighty cannot benefit them against You.

items.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَلاَ نَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ, لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الكَافِرُونَ.
items.tl: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah, la ilaha illallah, wa la na'budu illa iyyah, lahun-ni'matu wa lahul-fadlu wa lahuth-thana'ul-hasan. La ilaha illallahu mukhlisina lahud-dina wa law karihal-kafirun.
items.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is all praise, and He has power over everything. There is no might and no power except through Allah. There is no god but Allah, and we worship none but Him. His are the favor, the grace, and the finest praise. There is no god but Allah; we are sincere to Him in devotion, even if the disbelievers detest it.

items.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
items.tl: Subhanallah, walhamdulillah, wallahu akbar (thalathan wa thalathin). La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
items.en: Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, and Allah is the Greatest (said thirty-three times each). There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.

items.ar: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ* اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ* لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ* وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ﴾، بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ* مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ* وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ* وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ* وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾،بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ* مَلِكِ النَّاسِ* إِلَهِ النَّاسِ* مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ* الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ* مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ﴾ بَعْدَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ.
items.tl: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul huwa Allahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad. Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul a'udhu bi Rabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad. Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Rahim. Qul a'udhu bi Rabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi suduri-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas. Ba'da kulli salah.
items.en: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. ﴿Say: He is God, the One. God, the Eternal Refuge. He has not fathered anyone, nor was He born. And there is none comparable to Him.﴾ In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. ﴿Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, and from the evil of the darkness when it settles, and from the evil of those who blow upon knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.﴾ In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. ﴿Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the whispering withdrawer, who whispers in the hearts of mankind, from among jinn and mankind.﴾ (To be recited) after every prayer.

items.ar: ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾ عَقِبَ كلِّ صَلاَةٍ.
items.tl: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa, al-Hayyul-Qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. Man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih. Ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa huwal-'Aliyyul-'Azim. 'Aqiba kulli salah.
items.en: Allah — there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is there that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what lies before them and what lies behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not weigh upon Him. And He is the Most High, the Most Great. (To be recited after every prayer.)

items.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ عَشْرَ مَرّاتٍ بَعْدَ صَلاةِ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالصُّبْحِ.
items.tl: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, yuhyi wa yumit, wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir. (Ashra marratin ba'da salatil-maghribi was-subh.)
items.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and to Him belongs all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He has power over all things. (Ten times, after the Maghrib prayer and the Fajr prayer.)

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً بَعْدَ السّلامِ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الفَجْرِ.
items.tl: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan, ba'dassalami min salatil fajr.
items.en: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that benefits, for provision that is pure and lawful, and for deeds that are accepted. (To be said after giving the salam at the end of the Fajr prayer.)

items.ar: قَالَ جَابرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: كَانَ رسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَلِّمُنَا الْاسْتِخَارَةَ فِي الْأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا كَمَا يُعَلِّمُنَا السُّورَةَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ، يَقُولُ: إِذَا هَمَّ أَحَدُكُمْ بِالْأَمْرِ فَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنْ غَيْرِ الْفَرِيضَةِ، ثُمَّ لْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ العَظِيمِ؛ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الأمْرَ - وَيُسَمِّي حَاجَتَهُ - خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي – أَوْ قَالَ: عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ - فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي – أَوْ قَالَ: عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ – فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ، ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ.وَمَا نَدِمَ مَنِ اسْتَخَارَ الْخَالِقَ، وَشَاوَرَ الْمَخْلُوقِينَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَتَثَبَّتَ فِي أَمْرِهِ، فَقَدْ قَالَ اللَّه تعالى: ﴿وَشاوِرْهُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ .
items.tl: Qala Jabir ibn Abdillah radiyallahu anhuma: kana Rasulullah sallallahu alayhi wa sallam yu'allimuna al-istikhara fil-umuri kulliha kama yu'allimunas-surata minal-Qur'an, yaqul: idha hamma ahadukum bil-amri fal-yarka' rak'atayni min ghayril-faridah, thumma l-yaqul: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmik, wa astaqdiruka bi-qudratik, wa as'aluka min fadlikal-azim; fa-innaka taqdiru wa la aqdir, wa ta'lamu wa la a'lam, wa anta allamul-ghuyub. Allahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amr (wa yusammi hajatah) khayrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa aqibati amri (aw qala: ajilihi wa ajilih) faqdurhu li wa yassirhu li thumma barik li fih. Wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra sharrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa aqibati amri (aw qala: ajilihi wa ajilih) fasrifhu anni wasrifni anh, waqdur liyal-khayra haythu kan, thumma ardini bih. Wa ma nadima man istakharal-khaliq, wa shawaral-makhluqinal-mu'minin, wa tathabbata fi amrih, fa-qad qalallahu ta'ala: wa shawirhum fil-amri fa-idha azamta fa-tawakkal alallah.
items.en: Jabir ibn Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with them both) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to teach us to seek guidance (istikhara) in all matters, just as he would teach us a surah of the Quran. He would say: "When one of you intends to undertake some matter, let him pray two rak'ahs other than the obligatory prayer, and then say: 'O Allah, I seek Your guidance to what is best through Your knowledge, I seek ability through Your power, and I ask You from Your immense favor. For You are able and I am not, You know and I do not, and You are the Knower of all that is unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter (here he names his need) is good for me in my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affairs (or he said: in my present and my future), then decree it for me, make it easy for me, and then bless me in it. And if You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affairs (or he said: in my present and my future), then turn it away from me, turn me away from it, and decree for me the good wherever it may be, and then make me content with it.'" No one who seeks the choice of the Creator, consults believing people, and is steadfast in his decision will ever regret it. For Allah, the Exalted, has said: "And consult them in the matter; then once you have made a firm decision, put your trust in Allah."

categories.title: Worry & Grief
categories.subtitle: In times of worry and sadness

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُــــلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلاَءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي.
items.tl: Allahumma inni abduka, ibnu abdika, ibnu amatika, nasiyati biyadika, madin fiyya hukmuka, adlun fiyya qada'uka, as'aluka bikulli ismin huwa laka, sammayta bihi nafsaka, aw anzaltahu fi kitabika, aw allamtahu ahadan min khalqika, awi sta'tharta bihi fi ilmil-ghaybi indaka, an taj'alal-Qur'ana rabi'a qalbi, wa nura sadri, wa jala'a huzni, wa dhahaba hammi.
items.en: O Allah, I am Your servant, the son of Your servant, the son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand. Your ruling concerning me is certain to be carried out, and Your decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every name that belongs to You, by which You have named Yourself, or which You have sent down in Your Book, or taught to any of Your creation, or kept to Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen that is with You: make the Quran the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the remover of my sorrow, and the dispeller of my worry.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ.
items.tl: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.
items.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, and from being overwhelmed by debt and overpowered by men.

items.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ.
items.tl: La ilaha illallahu al-'Azeem al-Haleem. La ilaha illallahu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azeem. La ilaha illallahu Rabbus-samawati wa Rabbul-ardi wa Rabbul-'Arshil-Kareem.
items.en: There is no god but Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

items.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ.
items.tl: Allahumma rahmataka arju, fala takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn, wa aslih li sha'ni kullahu, la ilaha illa ant.
items.en: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for. So do not leave me to myself for even the blink of an eye, and set right all of my affairs for me. There is no god but You.

items.ar: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّالِمِينَ.
items.tl: La ilaha illa anta, subhanaka, inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
items.en: There is no god but You. Glory be to You! Truly, I have been among the wrongdoers.

items.ar: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً.
items.tl: Allahu Allahu Rabbi la ushriku bihi shay'a.
items.en: Allah, Allah is my Lord; I associate nothing with Him.
